name: @ph-dev-utils/bir
description: BIR (Bureau of Internal Revenue) tax utilities for the Philippines — VAT (12% / ₱3M threshold), percentage tax (3% standing, with historical 1% rate awareness), individual income tax (graduated TRAIN rates + 8% option), expanded withholding tax (EWT, RR 11-2018), and a reference list of commonly-used BIR forms.
